title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #19 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What do we ask Allah for in the sixth verse of Al-Fatiha? (1 mark)
   A. To make us win games
   B. To make us famous
   C. To guide us to the straight path
   D. To give us money

2. "Maliki yawmid-din" means (1 mark)
   A. Lord of all the worlds
   B. The Most Kind
   C. Master of the Day of Judgement
   D. Guide us to the path

3. What does it mean to "emulate" the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Copy his good example
   B. Argue with him
   C. Forget his words
   D. Fear him

4. Which is NOT a trait of the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Patience
   B. Truthfulness
   C. Cheating in trade
   D. Generosity

5. What does "Bismillah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. All praise is for Allah
   B. Allah is the Greatest
   C. In the name of Allah
   D. Glory be to Allah

6. Which of these is bad eating manners? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting calmly
   B. Waiting for elders
   C. Taking small bites
   D. Talking with a full mouth

7. Brushing teeth can become an act of worship when you (1 mark)
   A. Do it to show off
   B. Do it without thinking
   C. Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   D. Do it while angry

8. What is oral hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Cleaning the room
   B. Washing feet
   C. Cleaning clothes
   D. Keeping the mouth and teeth clean

9. How does physical fitness help worship? (1 mark)
   A. It replaces zakat
   B. It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   C. It makes prayer shorter
   D. It removes the need to pray

10. What is a good weekly fitness plan for a child? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting all day
   B. Only sweets
   C. About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   D. No sleep

11. Which value is learned from team games? (1 mark)
   A. Selfishness
   B. Teamwork
   C. Cheating
   D. Pride

12. What is the collection of Allah's most beautiful names called? (1 mark)
   A. Sunnah
   B. Arkan
   C. Asma'ul Husna
   D. Tajweed

13. Which of these is a mistake about Allah's names? (1 mark)
   A. Learning them
   B. Using them in dua
   C. Thinking Allah is like a human being
   D. Teaching them

14. Which dua matches the name As-Salam? (1 mark)
   A. Let me win
   B. Give me many toys
   C. Make me famous
   D. Grant us peace in our home and country

15. When the Qur'an (20:46) says Allah is with Musa and Harun "hearing and seeing", which names are shown? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   B. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   C. Al-Malik and As-Salam
   D. Ar-Rahim and As-Salam

16. Which verse teaches that nothing is like Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:1
   B. Qur'an 1:1
   C. Qur'an 42:11
   D. Qur'an 112:1

17. Which pillar of Iman are we practising when we say "I believe in the angels"? (1 mark)
   A. Belief in Allah's angels
   B. Belief in destiny
   C. Belief in the Last Day
   D. Belief in the books

18. Which of these do angels do? (1 mark)
   A. They never disobey Allah
   B. They sometimes disobey
   C. They are Allah's daughters
   D. They eat and sleep

19. The Qur'an mentions prophets in Surah 6 verses 84-86 and other places. Why should we learn their stories? (1 mark)
   A. To avoid work
   B. To boast
   C. To learn lessons and virtues
   D. To become kings

20. What is the difference between a nabi and a rasul? (1 mark)
   A. They are the same in every way
   B. A nabi is an angel
   C. A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   D. A rasul is a jinn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Choose any two prophets and explain one virtue from the life of each. (5 marks)

22. Distinguish between a nabi and a rasul. (2 marks)

23. Describe how the Prophet (S.A.W.) solved the dispute over placing the Black Stone. (3 marks)

24. Explain what a person should do if they do not like a food served to them. (3 marks)

25. Describe three Islamic manners to observe during games. (3 marks)

26. Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives. (5 marks)

27. Design a short role-play showing the etiquette of eating, listing at least five actions. (5 marks)

28. Write the meaning of the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas, "Qul huwallahu ahad". (2 marks)

29. What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — To guide us to the straight path
   The verse is "Guide us to the straight path".

2. C — Master of the Day of Judgement
   It is the fourth verse of Al-Fatiha.

3. A — Copy his good example
   To emulate is to follow an example.

4. C — Cheating in trade
   He never cheated on weights or measures.

5. C — In the name of Allah
   Bismillah means "In the name of Allah".

6. D — Talking with a full mouth
   Chewing with the mouth open and talking is impolite.

7. C — Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   Good intention makes daily acts worship.

8. D — Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   Oral means mouth.

9. B — It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   A healthy body helps us do our duties.

10. C — About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   Regular activity keeps fit.

11. B — Teamwork
   Working together builds teamwork.

12. C — Asma'ul Husna
   Asma'ul Husna means the Most Beautiful Names.

13. C — Thinking Allah is like a human being
   Nothing is like Allah.

14. D — Grant us peace in our home and country
   As-Salam is the Source of Peace.

15. A — As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   Allah hears and sees.

16. C — Qur'an 42:11
   It says there is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

17. A — Belief in Allah's angels
   It is the second pillar of Iman.

18. A — They never disobey Allah
   The Qur'an says they do what they are commanded.

19. C — To learn lessons and virtues
   The stories teach us how to behave.

20. C — A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   A messenger delivers a specific message.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ayyub showed patience in illness; Ibrahim showed generosity to guests.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each prophet, 1 mark for each virtue, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: A nabi is a prophet who receives revelation; a rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: He placed the stone on a cloak and asked a leader from each tribe to hold an edge and lift it together, then he set it in place.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cloak, 1 mark for leaders lifting together, 1 mark for setting it in place.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave it quietly and politely without criticising, as the Prophet did, and thank the person.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not criticising, 1 mark for quietness or politeness, 1 mark for thanks.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dress modestly, keep the times of prayer, avoid cheating and insults, respect others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands; sit; say Bismillah; eat with right hand; eat from in front; do not criticise; say Alhamdulillah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action, up to 5.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say: He is Allah, the One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "Say" and 1 mark for "Allah is One".

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.
